children: new car registrations in Germany more than doubled in August, German road traffic agency KBA said on Thursday.
KBA said 3,034 new Tesla cars were registered in August, up by 110.5% year-over-year.
The number of Tesla cars registered between January and August rose 182% to 32,258 units compared with the same period last year.
